name: 왕좌를 되찾는 영주
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual pixel-art animation sprite sheet for Re:Trap, a side-view 2D castle trap platformer. Create ONE coherent protagonist sprite sheet, transparent background. Protagonist: displaced medieval lord reclaiming his demon-corrupted castle, small gold crown, expressive face, short dark hair, blue-steel light armor, burgundy cape, gold clasp, no weapon. Strong readable silhouette, 16-bit hand-pixeled aesthetic, hard square pixels, limited palette, no smooth painted shading, no text, no grid lines, no shadows on background. EXACT layout 4 columns by 8 rows of equal cells, 32 sprites, all same scale facing RIGHT, fixed baseline and centered pivot within each cell, generous empty padding and no overlap. Every row a continuous animation sequence left to right with consistent character design. Row1 idle breathing 4 frames; row2 running 4 distinct leg-cycle frames; row3 jump takeoff rising 4 frames; row4 falling 4 frames; row5 landing squash recover 4 frames; row6 invincible forward dash 4 frames cape trails golden small sparks; row7 recoil hit 4 frames; row8 death kneel fall fade to small golden spirit 4 frames, no gore. Square canvas 1024x1024. These are small game sprites, not concept portraits. Each frame fits in its cell completely, feet baseline at 85 percent of cell height except air/death movements. Genuine alpha transparency.
